static_traits.name: Chen Siyu
static_traits.social_status: Having friends to confide in, but finding it hard to discuss insecurity and Self-doubt with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to Reflect on one's own thoughts and feelings, fairly cooperative; slightly Anxious and shy when discussing topics of being evaluated

basic_info.main_problem: Worrying about being seen as childish by others because of a preference for green, triggering insecurity and Self-doubt, especially noticeable in Social situations or when discussing personal preferences.
basic_info.core_demands: This insecurity affects self-esteem and causes distress, so hoping to alleviate the discomfort through counseling.

core_beliefs: Others will evaluate me negatively because of my personal preferences

special_situations.event: At a company lunch, a colleague jokingly called green 'a color like the ones children like', publicly remarking on their liking for green
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others label my preference as childish, it means I am indeed immature
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterward avoiding mentioning green or quickly seeking comfort from friends to relieve discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am like a child

special_situations.event: In social settings where personal preferences need to be discussed or he is asked about his favorite color
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express a preference inconsistent with the majority, I will be seen as immature and mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Talks as little as possible about personal preferences, or observes others' reactions first before expressing cautiously
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I say I like green, everyone will think I am childish

special_situations.event: After receiving others' comments or jokes about liking green
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others calling me childish means liking green has no positive meaning at all
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring their own positive associations with green (calm, nature, growth) and instead focusing on the negative comments
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Liking green only makes me look childish; other reasons do not matter

special_situations.event: Asked about personal preferences and thinking of others' past jokes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' words are the standard for judging my worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking affirmation and comfort from friends to Gain recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Only with their approval will I not look childish

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and have personal preferences respected (hoping to express oneself freely without being judged)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being mocked and humiliated, worrying about being negated and losing respect for expressing preferences
defense_goal: Avoiding being humiliated again by internalizing external evaluations and restraining myself
Reduces exposure of personal preferences in social settings to maintain safety

object_relations.self_representation: A self prone to judgment and shame

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others joke about or comment on their preference for the color green, or when these comments are explored in counseling
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Taking outside comments as authoritative standards, believing one is indeed 'immature' (transference: bringing the image of judgmental others into the current interaction)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle, supportive tone; first Empathizing and naming shame/Anxiety, then inviting distinguishing the boundary between 'others' views and one's own preferences'; using open-ended Questioning to guide reality testing, avoiding judgment; pausing moderately to reduce tension.

manifestations: Difficulty discussing insecurity and Self-doubt with friends
Feeling alienated and misunderstood in Social situations out of fear of being judged
outcomes: Tension and avoidance in interpersonal interactions
Relying on external approval to maintain self-esteem

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes others' joke of 'like a child' as a standard for judging one's own maturity
When expressing personal preferences, judges self according to external labels

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively cares about others' views and possible evaluations in social settings
Frequently seeking comfort and affirmation from others to relieve unease

positive_force: Having a certain degree of self-Reflection and expressive ability (able to clearly describe situations and thoughts)
Has a friend support network (can confide)
Work functioning not yet affected, life structure fairly stable
Able to identify and articulate the positive meaning of liking green (calm, nature, growth)
negative_force: Significant Self-doubt, easily influenced by others' evaluations
Tends to rely on external approval and comfort
Prone to shame and Anxiety when discussing personal preferences in social settings
Highly sensitive to negative comments, ignores positive evidence

target_behavior.behavior: Significant insecurity and Self-doubt when discussing personal preferences in Social situations (accompanied by shame and Anxiety)
antecedent: Being asked about a favorite color
Hears comments or jokes about 'liking green is childish'
Discussing personal preferences with colleagues / friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing others' jokes and comments as judgments of one's maturity, and Anticipating continued negative evaluations from others (mind-reading/fortune-telling), thereby triggering shame and Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of being evaluated, protecting self-esteem, reducing discomfort through cautious expression
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal interactions affected, maintaining the Anxiety and Self-doubt cycle, difficulty freely expressing oneself

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeking comfort and affirmation from friends to relieve unease
antecedent: When feeling insecure and self-doubting after socializing
After recalling others' jokes or comments about liking green
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-esteem depends on external recognition to repair the self-worth eroded by shame
target_behavior.function: Gaining comfort and temporary self-worth confirmation
target_behavior.consequence: Short-term relief but unable to improve long-term, possibly increasing dependence on others' affirmation and straining Relationships
